parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` in the `Wallpaper` package. The path contains `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp`, which is a canonical sample-app location. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where at least one record sits under an Examples/ or SampleApp/ path must be treated as a sample-app mirror and no refactoring action should be taken. Lifting `DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next` from the sample app into shared production code in `DebugPanel` would couple production semantics to demonstration code, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
